== Ingredients ==
* 48 jumbo peeled, deveined [[Cookbook:Shrimp|shrimp]]
* 12 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] [[Cookbook:Beer|beer]] (recommended: Budweiser)
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] salt
* 1 tbsp freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], divided

== Procedure ==
#Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat. Add shrimp and cook until slightly undercooked. Quickly place shrimp in ice water and drain. Set aside.
#Season shrimp with salt and pepper. [[Cookbook:Deglazing|Deglaze]] pot with beer and add shrimp. Bring to a [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] over medium low heat.
#Once beer simmers, lower heat to low and cook 5 minutes.
#Stir in butter 1 tbsp at a time and serve warm.

steps.text: Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat. Add shrimp and cook until slightly undercooked. Quickly place shrimp in ice water and drain. Set aside.
Season shrimp with salt and pepper. Deglaze pot with beer and add shrimp. Bring to a simmer over medium low heat.
Once beer simmers, lower heat to low and cook 5 minutes.
Stir in butter 1 tbsp at a time and serve warm.
